Third-party software in site/vendor/
=====================================

site/vendor/docx.umd.js is the UMD build of the npm package docx@9.14.0, copied unmodified from the package's
dist/index.umd.cjs (SHA-256 verified against the npm tarball). It is loaded only from our own origin, and only when you download a Word file.

  SHA-256 of docx.umd.js: 2024b090d888c4d0396d3088ae72b841de1e69e8a5bd8373e34ea31413d9dfdf
  (checked by tests/web/render.test.js; update both together when the library is upgraded)

The bundle contains docx itself and the packages below, which its build (rolldown + vite-plugin-node-polyfills)
inlined. The list was taken from the "//#region node_modules/..." markers in the bundle; versions are those npm
resolves for docx@9.14.0 and vite-plugin-node-polyfills@0.28.0 (the bundle itself does not record versions).

---------------------------  -------  -----------------------  ---------------------------------------------------

                                      "MIT OR GPL-3.0-or-later")  Franz Buchinger, Antonio Afonso
  bundled inside jszip.min.js:
  pako                       1.0.11   MIT AND Zlib             Copyright (C) 2014-2017 by Vitaly Puzrin and Andrei Tuputcyn

The full docx licence is in docx.LICENSE beside this file.

site/vendor/pptxgen.bundle.js is the browser bundle of the npm package pptxgenjs@4.0.1 (published 2025-06-26), copied
unmodified from the package's dist/pptxgen.bundle.js (SHA-256 verified against the npm tarball). It is loaded only from our
own origin, and only when you download a PowerPoint file. It never fetches anything: Keelson passes every image as data.

  SHA-256 of pptxgen.bundle.js: 4fb9eac5cfefb213e2d8743c2b7151025f31bfb3f834c73c12062916daa0f3f8
  (checked by tests/web/pptx.test.js; update both together when the library is upgraded)

The bundle is a prebuilt JSZip followed by PptxGenJS. The list was taken from the version strings and module markers in the
bundle (JSZip "3.10.1", core-js "2.6.11"; pako, lie and setImmediate code) and JSZip 3.10.1's dependencies.

Package                      Version  Licence                  Copyright
---------------------------  -------  -----------------------  ---------------------------------------------------
pptxgenjs                    4.0.1    MIT                      Copyright (c) 2015-2022 Brent Ely
jszip                        3.10.1   MIT (chosen from         Copyright (c) 2009-2016 Stuart Knightley, David Duponchel,
                                      "MIT OR GPL-3.0-or-later")  Franz Buchinger, Antonio Afonso
  bundled inside it:
  pako                       1.0.x    MIT AND Zlib             Copyright (C) 2014-2017 by Vitaly Puzrin and Andrei Tuputcyn
  lie                        3.3.0    MIT                      Copyright (c) 2014-2018 Calvin Metcalf, Jordan Harband
  immediate                  3.0.6    MIT                      Copyright (c) 2012 Barnesandnoble.com, llc, Donavon West,
                                                               Domenic Denicola, Brian Cavalier
  setimmediate               1.0.5    MIT                      Copyright (c) 2012 Barnesandnoble.com, llc, Donavon West,
                                                               and Domenic Denicola
  readable-stream            2.3.x    MIT                      Copyright Node.js contributors. All rights reserved.
  core-js                    2.6.11   MIT                      Copyright (c) 2014-2019 Denis Pushkarev

The full pptxgenjs licence is in pptxgenjs.LICENSE beside this file. The MIT, zlib and other licence texts below apply to
the packages in both bundles.

Fonts in site/fonts/
====================

plus-jakarta-sans-500.woff2 and plus-jakarta-sans-800.woff2 are Plus Jakarta Sans (weights 500 and 800), served from our own
origin (no font CDN).

Font                 Licence                      Copyright
-------------------  ---------------------------  ------------------------------------------------------------------
Plus Jakarta Sans    SIL Open Font License 1.1    Copyright 2020 The Plus Jakarta Sans Project Authors
                                                  (https://github.com/tokotype/PlusJakartaSans)

The full licence text is in site/fonts/OFL-PlusJakartaSans.txt, published alongside the fonts.

site/vendor/pts.min.js is dist/pts.min.js from the npm package pts@1.0.3 (https://github.com/williamngan/pts),
with only its sourceMappingURL comment removed. It is loaded only from our own origin, and only when you open the Dashboard.

  Package  Version  Licence     Copyright
  pts      1.0.3    Apache-2.0  Copyright © 2017-present William Ngan and contributors
  SHA-256 of pts.min.js: 3953b93e53dcf693bbd28b2e5c618c4790df25c1123dd6657d9695162c38d381

The full licence text is in site/vendor/pts.LICENSE, published alongside the library.
